title: The Vale Mansion Case
premise: Detective Elias Wren arrives at Vale Mansion after Emma Vale's death, where a missing ledger payment may expose why the truth was buried.
central_question: Can Elias trace the missing payment, prevent a false accusation, and uncover who concealed the truth about Emma Vale's death?

initial_world_state.opening_situation: Rain and fresh mud mark the steps outside Vale Mansion. Emma Vale was last seen shortly before midnight in the west gallery.

protagonist.name: Detective Elias Wren
protagonist.background: A detective haunted by an old failure who has only just arrived at the mansion.

public_briefing.timeline: Emma Vale was last seen shortly before midnight in the west gallery.

opening_contact.scene_purpose: Brief Elias on the public outline of the death, then bring him inside to review the case file.

locations.front_steps: Outside the mansion, beside the drive and its mud-marked path.
locations.foyer: The dim mansion entry beneath shuttered portraits.
locations.market_lane: The lane where a route key marks a service passage.
locations.records_office: A place to trace the ledger payment.
locations.safehouse: A concealed refuge beyond the records office.
locations.watch_tower: A sheltered overlook above the service route.

case_file.description: The case file identifies Emma Vale, her public timeline, the groundskeeper as lead suspect, and a final ledger entry time-stamped 11:40 p.m.—twenty minutes before Emma was last seen.

ledger_page.description: A weather-sensitive ledger page records a missing payment tied to Vale Mansion and tonight's visit.

route_key.description: The route key marks a service passage someone expected to use after dark.

arrival_sedan.description: Elias's dark sedan remains by the drive where he left it after arriving at the mansion.

characters.name: Detective Elias Wren
characters.description: An observant detective haunted by an old failure, newly arrived to investigate Emma Vale's death.

characters.name: Daria Stone
characters.description: Elias's observant assistant, waiting on the mansion steps with the case file and ledger page.

characters.name: Emma Vale
characters.description: The mansion resident whose death and missing-payment trail start the case.

characters.name: The Groundskeeper
characters.description: The last verified witness to see Emma alive, whose apparent guilt must be tested rather than presumed.

protected_revelations.summary: The missing ledger payment identifies who concealed the truth about Emma Vale's death.

beats.summary: Review Daria's case file and establish the public facts plus its time-stamped ledger entry.

completion_tags.description: Elias has reviewed the victim timeline, lead suspect, missing-payment lead, and the 11:40 p.m. ledger entry.

beats.summary: Follow the ledger page and route key through the mansion's service passage to establish a reliable payment trail.

completion_tags.description: A reliable trail connects the missing payment to the night of Emma Vale's death.

beats.summary: Test the case against the groundskeeper before the household turns suspicion into a false accusation.

completion_tags.description: The evidence prevents the groundskeeper from being condemned without proof.

beats.summary: Confront the person responsible for concealing the payment trail and the truth about Emma Vale's death.

completion_tags.description: The concealed truth behind Emma Vale's death is established by evidence.

beats.summary: Show what accountability and the restored record mean for Vale Mansion after the truth is exposed.

completion_tags.description: The case's outcome and its consequences for the mansion are clear.
